title: Lunette project configuration
description: The values a Lunette project's skills and scripts read: .agents/config.jsonc or .agents/config.yml. One section per process area; a section is added when a skill needs it. The reasons behind a value go in a comment next to it, the longer ones in docs/process/<area>.md.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

lunette.description: Where this project came from: written once by @lntt/create when it scaffolds the project. A template update is computed from it.

template.description: The Lunette template the project was scaffolded from (react-router, …).

ci.description: How the project's CI runs: in the cloud, from the provider's own configuration, and locally with ci:local (@lntt/ci).

local.description: What ci:local does where the cloud configuration alone cannot say: the jobs it leaves to the cloud, the fake values it stands in for secrets with, and the actions it maps.

cloudOnly.description: Jobs that run only in the cloud (real secrets, a release, a deploy), by key: `<workflow file>/<job>` or a whole `<workflow file>` for GitHub Actions, `circleci/<job>` for CircleCI. The value is the reason, shown in the report.

fake.description: Values a local run uses in place of the cloud's, for canaries and checks that only need a value to be present. Never a real secret: this file is tracked.

secrets.description: secrets.<NAME> in GitHub Actions; environment variables of every CircleCI job.

actions.description: What a local run does for a GitHub Actions `uses:` it does not know, by action name without the ref (`owner/repo[/path]`): a command to run instead, or a skip with its reason. An action listed nowhere fails the run.

run.description: A shell command run from the repository root.

skip.description: Why nothing needs to run locally.

delivery.description: How a change reaches the main branch: branch names, commit messages, the candidate branch; pull request body, review and merge rules as skills need them.

branches.description: Branch names: <type>/<issue>/<slug>, or <type>/no-issue/<slug>, computed, checked and fixed by lntt branch. The base, the candidates (candidate.base, candidate.prefix) and Dependabot's branches are exempt; the hotfix prefix counts as one more type.

types.description: The accepted types. Default feat, fix, chore, refactor, docs, test, ci, perf, build.

candidate.description: The candidate branch that collects pull requests before they reach the base together, read by the candidate automation (lntt ci candidate). Without this section the automation does nothing.

base.description: The branch candidates merge into. Default main.

prefix.description: The candidate branch prefix, followed by an incremental number: candidate/ gives candidate/1, candidate/2.

hotfix.description: A pull request whose branch starts with prefix, or that carries label, stays on the base.

status.description: The board Status options the automation sets on the issues a pull request closes. The options belong to the Project and are added from its web UI: the automation never creates one.

inRelease.description: Set when the pull request is squashed into a candidate. Default In release.

done.description: Set when the candidate merges. Default Done.

commits.description: Commit message rules, read by commitlint (through @lntt/lntt) and by the commit-message skill.

language.description: Language of subjects and bodies, as a BCP 47 tag.

scopes.description: The only scopes allowed; omit to allow any.

maxLineLength.description: Longest header, body or footer line. Default 100.

longTrailers.description: Trailers whose value is a sentence (Retro), exempt from the line limit.

review.description: Who reviews a change before its pull request is marked ready, read by lntt review: each lens runs on its agents at once, with no context and no tool that writes; blockers and warnings go to verifiers briefed to refute them (docs/process/delivery.md).

reviewers.description: The lenses, by name. decisions, code and tests ship with the package (defaults: decisions on claude haiku, code and tests on claude sonnet, tests only when the diff touches test files); any other lens needs its brief. A lens given no agents is off.

with.description: The agents that review through this lens, all at once.

brief.description: A file in the repository with the lens's instructions, for a lens the package does not ship.

paths.description: Globs: the lens runs only when the diff touches one of them. Default: always (tests: test files).

verify.description: The adversarial check, or false for none. Default: claude sonnet, for blockers and warnings.

with.description: The verifiers, each asked to refute every finding at once; an agent that found the finding verifies it only when no other is listed.

severities.description: The severities verified. Default blocker, warning.

timeoutMinutes.description: How long one agent may take, from when it starts, before it is stopped (with whatever it started) and counts as failed. Default 20.

perProvider.description: How many required agents of one provider run at once, and as many optional ones in a queue of their own; the others wait their turn. A provider given dozens of sessions at once queues or limits them until they time out. Default 4.

optionalGraceMinutes.description: How long optional agents may go on once every other agent of the step has answered; then they are stopped and reported in skipped, and those still waiting never start. Default 2.

roundTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a whole round may take; then every agent still running is stopped, the round fails and keeps what it gathered. Default 60.

maxRounds.description: How many rounds a branch may take: the round past it does not start, and lntt review exits 3 with what is still open for the person to decide. lntt review allow gives one branch more. Default 4.

recording.description: How the project records its decisions: which logs exist, where, and in which language.

language.description: Language the records are written in, as a BCP 47 tag (en, it).

logs.description: The decision logs, by name (adr, product, process). Each one is a folder of thematic files corrected in place.

externalReferences.description: Files whose paths to records name another project's (a shared package or a skill citing the records of the project that installs it), by glob from the repository root. The value is the reason. lntt check decisions does not resolve their paths and links; a glob that matches no file fails the check.

tests.description: How the project's tests are organised, read by lntt check tests and by the tests lens of lntt review.

levels.description: The test levels, lowest first: a test sits at the lowest level where its assertion can fail for the right reason. Every test file (a *.test.* or *.spec.* file, or one a level's files names) matches exactly one level; the pyramid per level is reported, never thresholded.

rules.description: Patterns the project forbids in tests, each with the record behind it.

ignore.description: Globs of files named like tests that are not tests (fixtures a test reads).

assertions.description: Functions that fail the test by throwing, which count as an assertion besides expect, assert and the names containing assert, expect, verify or check (run, runOrThrow).

local.description: How the apps are started and reached locally, read by the run-local skill and lntt local.

up.description: Starts them when they do not answer.

check.description: Exits 0 when they already answer; then they are reused, never restarted.

description.description: What the app is, in one line.

port.description: Base port: the main checkout uses it, each linked worktree gets base + 10 × its slot.

url.description: Where the app answers; {port} is replaced by the worktree's port.

readyPath.description: Path polled until it answers, after start. Default /.

commands.description: Commands for this app by name (start, migrate, logs, …); start is required.

run.description: The command, run from the repository root; {port} is replaced by the worktree's port.
The command, run from the repository root; {port} is replaced by the worktree's port.

env.description: Variables set when a command runs; {port} is replaced.

signIn.description: How to sign in: a test that does it, and a description for what a test cannot say.

test.description: Path of a test or setup file that signs in.

doc.description: Path (and anchor) of the prose, usually in docs/process/local.md.

users.description: Seeded users, by name. Never a password: how to sign in is in signIn.

coordinator.description: Coordinator mode, read by lntt worktree start and the coordinate skill: a theme's parent worktree delegates each issue to a child worktree and writes no code. Reviews keep delivery.review; nothing here changes them.

gate.description: Whether a coordinator may start a child on its own. propose (default): lntt worktree start --theme asks the orchestrator through lntt ask and creates the child only on an answer that is approve, approved, yes or ok, unless the issue was listed with --approve when the coordinator started or approved before. free: it starts at once.

models.description: The agent per role. A role without an entry runs on the agent's own default; --kind, --model and --effort on the command line win over these.

children.description: The child's agent by the issue's Size (lntt worktree start --size).

path.description: Folder of the log, relative to the repository root.

index.description: The file that lists the records, relative to the repository root.

template.description: The file a new record is copied from, relative to the repository root. The statuses its frontmatter lists (`status: proposed # proposed | accepted`) are the ones lntt check decisions accepts in the log's records.

scope.description: What this log records, in one sentence, so a decision is filed in the right one.

name.description: The level's name (unit, component, integration, e2e).

files.description: Globs from the project root of the test files at this level.

exclude.description: Globs of files the level's files do not take, so that each test file matches one level.

environment.description: What the level runs in (node, jsdom, chromium, node and a real Postgres): reported, not checked.

harness.description: Identifiers a file at this level must open (tx, withTestDb, createTestDb): a file that names none of them does not integrate and fails the check.

run.description: The command that runs test files of this level, from `cwd`; {files} is replaced by the files, relative to `cwd`, shell-quoted. Exit 0 when they pass. Read by lntt check tests mutate.

coverage.description: Like run, plus coverage: it must write an lcov file at {out}/lcov.info. Read by lntt check tests touched; without it the tests of a line are found from imports.

cwd.description: Folder, from the project root, where run and coverage start. Default the root.

repeat.description: How many times in a row a mutation run executes the tests (a browser test that is flaky once passes by luck). Default 1.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long one run of the command may take. Default 600.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression matched against each line of a test file; a match is a violation.

files.description: Globs of the files the rule applies to. Default every test file.

message.description: What is wrong and what to write instead.

anchor.description: The record behind the rule: path#heading of a decision.

assertedBy.description: A test in the project's own suite that already fails on this pattern: the rule is cited with it and not checked again.

kind.description: The agent CLI, run headless and read-only. The diff and the files it reads go to the provider that serves its model: the project's choice, with that provider's terms on data; lntt review names the destinations in every round.

model.description: The model, as the agent names it: an alias or id for claude, provider/model for opencode (the provider part says where the diff goes). Default: the agent's own.

optional.description: A failure of this agent (a free model that times out) is reported in skipped and does not fail the round. Default false.

kind.description: The agent CLI as Orca's --agent and Herdr's --kind name it (claude, codex, opencode). Default claude.

model.description: The model, as the agent names it. Default: the agent's own.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, for the agents that take one.
